notes.title: Update list for DNA
notes.notes:
First of all :
I have changed my name of Studio in [b]Fogrim Studio[/b]
So you can follow me, have a look on the DNA developement :
[url=https://twitter.com/Fogrim_Studio]TWITTER[/url]

Particularly on Discord where I'm the most active ! (Really active on Discord my man)
>>> [url=https://discord.gg/K3Scw6YCrY]DISCORD[/url] <<< Where you can play to DNA free :)

Here a list of updates for DNA and new integrations :

- A board of Upgrades for the player (minimum 14 skills to unloack and improves)
- Add fog and 3 types of rain (wind and thunder in the futur)
- Total rework of HUD
- Vendor mechanic (sell and buy all types of items)
- Zombies decapitation and dismemberment
- continue level design of the island
- improve the day & night cycle, the apparence of the lights
- more particles and visibility for the items, doors, fired bullets
- changed the keyboard keys in the options
- balance hunger/thirst/sleep/sprint for the hero
- new items (energy drink, beer, paracetamol...)
- better integration of the text files for a translation of the game by the community
- support 4K monitor
and more...

In the next few days, I will update the screenshots of the Steam page of DNA

Thanks for reading the survivors !
Don't forget you can play to DNA in joining my Discord ;)

- Fogrim Studio
